sn48.65:1.1: Pañcimāni bhikkhave indriyāni || katamāni pañca || || Saddhindriyaṃ || la-pe || paññindriyaṃ || || Imāni kho bhikkhave pañcindriyāni || || Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannam indriyānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā dvinnam phalānam aññataram phalam pāṭikaṅkham diṭṭheva dhamme aññā sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā ti || || Pañcimani
